data.text: I’m in: **15 tons this month; $15,000 donated directly to the clinic**, with Luke taking zero and our combined catch capped at 60 tons. Our neighbors need treatment today, and we owe them a healthy lake afterward. I also commit to **no more than six tons next month**, returning to ten each only once the lake is back at 100. Let’s record the catches and clinic receipts together so we can follow through on both promises.
